description: Use this when the person asks who their ideal customer is, or needs to explain who buys from them and why. Returns everything Andru knows about the ideal customer: 5 layers of buyer intelligence, the 7 questions every buyer asks, and the patterns that predict churn. Optionally filter to specific layers.

includeAntiPatterns.description: Include anti-patterns and churn predictors (default: true)

includeSevenAnswers.description: Include seven critical buyer answers (default: true)

layers.description: Specific layers to include (1-5). Omit for all layers.

name: get_icp_profile
title: Read your ideal customer profile
